Article Title: Phone numbers, QR code: Punjab BJP's new push to seek public input for 2027 'people's manifesto'
Article Text:
Punjab BJP chief Kewal Singh Dhillon announced three phone numbers and a QR code to collect public suggestions for the party's 2027 Assembly poll manifesto

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Punjab BJP on Sunday launched three phone numbers and a QR code to seek suggestions from people across the state for preparing its “people’s manifesto” ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Punjab BJP chief Kewal Singh Dhillon announced the initiative, saying suggestions from all sections of society would be considered while drafting the manifesto.“We will welcome suggestions from every section and thereafter the poll manifesto will be prepared. It will be a people’s manifesto,” news agency PTI quoted Dhillon as saying.“We have only one agenda, which is Punjab’s progress and development. It will be a manifesto for every Punjabi,” he said.The three phone numbers launched by the party are 07971943333, 9913002027 and 7508560065. People can also scan a QR code to submit their suggestions.Apart from the phone numbers and QR code, the BJP will send vans to villages and cities across Punjab to collect suggestions from people for its manifesto, Dhillon said.The party said the exercise was aimed at gathering inputs from different sections of society before finalising its agenda for the 2027 polls.Dhillon also targeted the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government in Punjab over law and order, the drug menace, gangsterism and rising debt.Accusing the state government of having “destroyed Punjab” during its tenure, he claimed that the state had fallen behind in development. He also alleged that the AAP government had failed to ensure that funds sent by the Centre reached the people.The Punjab BJP chief further claimed that the state's outstanding debt had nearly doubled under the AAP government, rising from Rs 2.82 lakh crore.
Article Summary: Punjab BJP launches three phone numbers and a QR code to collect public suggestions for the party's 2027 Assembly poll manifesto. Punjab BJP chief Kewal Singh Dhillon says suggestions from all sections of society would be considered while drafting the manifesto.

Article Title: Watch: Hours after PM Modi inaugurates Nitish Setu, RJD workers tear down NDA banners
Article Text:
RJD workers tear down NDA banners on Nitish Setu

Row over the bridge’s name

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: A political showdown erupted on Bihar’s newly inaugurated Nitish Setu on Saturday, with Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) workers pulling down banners and posters put up by the ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA), hours after Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the bridge in Vaishali.Videos circulating on social media showed a large group of RJD supporters, tearing down the displays and shouting slogans in support of party supremo Lalu Prasad Yadav and leader of opposition Tejashwi Yadav. Police personnel were seen moving alongside the crowd but appeared unable to control the gathering.The disruption has triggered a fresh exchange between the BJP and RJD, turning the inauguration of a major infrastructure project into a political flashpoint.BJP has accused the RJD of trying to politicise a development project rather than acknowledge its benefits.The bridge, named Nitish Setu, was inaugurated by PM Modi on November 21. The six-lane structure has been built at an estimated cost of Rs 4,280 crore and connects Kacchi Dargah with Bidupur. It is expected to improve connectivity between north and south Bihar and reduce pressure on Mahatma Gandhi Setu.The naming of a bridge in Bihar has triggered a political row, with the Congress and RJD questioning the decision to christen it Nitish Setu instead of naming it after Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru.Congress leader Pawan Khera accused the BJP-led Bihar government of hurting Sikh sentiments through the decision. In a post on X, he questioned why a bridge proposed to be named after Guru Gobind Singh was now being named after Nitish Kumar, and whether the move was aimed at pushing the former chief minister out of the political mainstream. "Why is this being done in a way that tramples on the sentiments of the Sikh community?" he asked.Khera also questioned the timing, saying it raised concerns about whether the JD(U) leader was being sidelined while still alive. He shared a Bihar Road Construction Department document containing a note on a non-official resolution moved by RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav regarding the proposed name.Tejashwi had earlier said he moved a private member's resolution in the Bihar Assembly proposing the bridge be named after Guru Gobind Singh. He accused the government of changing its position and said the decision was politically motivated. The Bihar Assembly later said no decision had been taken in the House to name the bridge after Guru Gobind Singh.The controversy has also drawn criticism from AAP leaders in Punjab. Finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema, Assembly speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan and MLA Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal urged the Bihar government to reconsider, saying the bridge's proximity to Takht Sri Patna Sahib made the issue particularly sensitive. Cheema said the government could honour Nitish Kumar in other ways, but going back on a proposal to honour Guru Gobind Singh was unacceptable. Dhaliwal called the decision an insult to Sikh sentiments.Tejashwi also questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi's inauguration of the bridge, claiming Nitish Kumar had opened it around 17 months earlier and that the project was already in use. He challenged the BJP to identify its contribution to the construction.The inauguration also brought back a familiar election-season image: PM Modi waved his gamcha during the event, recalling his appearance at the BJP office in Patna after the NDA’s victory in the 2025 Bihar assembly elections. The gesture had gone viral at the time, with “Modi Ka Gamcha” trending online after the alliance won 202 of the state’s 243 seats.The bridge inauguration was attended by Bihar governor Lt Gen Syed Ata Hasnain (retd), Union minister Chirag Paswan, chief minister Samrat Choudhary and other dignitaries.
Article Summary: RJD workers tear down NDA banners on Nitish Setu bridge. Row over the bridge’s name has triggered a political flashpoint. BJP has accused the RJD of trying to politicise a development project. Six-lane structure has been built at an estimated cost of Rs 4,280 crore.

Article Title: ‘Vote Chori’ allegations: Nitin Nabin to lead BJP's Hyderabad rally to counter criticism
Article Text:
BJP President Nitin Nabin

NEW DELHI: BJP president Nitin Nabin will lead a rally in Hyderabad on Monday to counter criticism of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and allegations of "vote chori" (vote theft), Union minister Bandi Sanjay Kumar said on Sunday.The BJP MP from Karimnagar described the rally as a "historic" event, predicting a massive turnout of party workers and members of the public, ANI reported.He accused those opposing the exercise of acting against the country's interests, arguing that only Indian citizens should decide who becomes the prime minister or chief minister and elect their representatives."We will not let a Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Afghan or others to decide. That's why, SIR has been brought," he told reporters, as per ANI.Kumar also dismissed Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy's recent assertion that the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) was the Congress's principal political rival in the state. He alleged that the Congress and BRS were working together and said the chief minister's remarks indicated this.Claiming that Reddy was concerned about the BJP's growing presence in Telangana, the Union minister questioned how the BRS could be considered a major challenger when it had no Lok Sabha members and had not won a municipal corporation.He alleged that the Congress and BRS were attempting to prevent the BJP's expansion in the state and expressed confidence that his party would form the next government after the 2028 Assembly elections.The BJP has been organising rallies in several cities to counter allegations of electoral malpractice levelled by the Congress and other opposition parties.
Article Summary: BJP president Nitin Nabin will lead a rally in Hyderabad on Monday to counter criticism of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The BJP MP from Karimnagar described the rally as a "historic" event, predicting a massive turnout.

Article Title: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute dies of cardiac arrest in Delhi
Article Text:
Ramrao Wadkute

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Sakharam Wadkute died following a cardiac arrest at a hospital in New Delhi, family sources said on Sunday. He was 72.Wadkute was admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) on November 20 after complaining of a cough. He suffered a heart attack around 6 pm on Saturday and died during treatment at around 11.45 pm, the sources said.A native of Parbhani in Maharashtra's Marathwada region, Wadkute was elected to the Rajya Sabha in April this year. He had earlier served as a member of the Maharashtra Legislative Council from June 2014 to October 2019. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condoled his death, describing it as the loss of a simple and dedicated political leader who was deeply committed to grassroots welfare.Fadnavis said Wadkute had held several organisational responsibilities in the BJP in Hingoli district and worked extensively for the Dhangar community. He also served as chairman of the Sheep and Goat Development Corporation and made his mark in the cooperative sector, the chief minister added.Vice President and Rajya Sabha Chairman C P Radhakrishnan also expressed grief over Wadkute's demise, saying his contributions to public life and service to the people would always be remembered.Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla said, "The passing of Rajya Sabha MP Dr Ramrao Sakharam Wadkute ji is deeply saddening.In this hour of grief, my heartfelt condolences are with the bereaved family. May the departed soul rest in peace and may the family find the strength to bear this immense loss."Maharashtra Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar, in a post on X, said, "The news of the tragic passing of Hon. Ramraoji Wadkute, Member of the Rajya Sabha, in Delhi following a severe heart attack is deeply painful and heartbreaking. At this difficult time, we share in the grief of the Wadkute family."According to family sources, Wadkute's body will be kept for last respects in Parbhani on Monday. It will then be taken to Hingoli, where his last rites will be performed on Tuesday.
Article Summary: Wadkute was admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) on November 20 after complaining of a cough. He suffered a heart attack around 6 pm on Saturday and died during treatment at around 11.45 pm, the sources said. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condoled his death.

Article Title: ‘JD(U) has only a few months left’: JMM leader after Nitish Kumar skips 'Nitish Setu' inauguration
Article Text:
Kumar's absence from the inauguration of the Nitish Setu bridge in Vaishali district

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) leader Manoj Pandey on Sunday launched a fresh attack on former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar , claiming that the JD(U) had only a few months left and was moving towards its political end.Pandey's remarks came amid a political controversy over Kumar's absence from the inauguration of the Nitish Setu bridge in Vaishali district. Speaking to ANI, the JMM leader questioned the repeat inauguration of the project and accused the BJP of taking credit for its construction despite, as he claimed, having no contribution to it.“At the Nitish Setu bridge's inauguration, Nitish Kumar himself was nowhere to be seen. The bridge was there, but Nitish was not. Besides, it had already been inaugurated in the past. What is the intention behind doing it again? What kind of 'development' concept is this? It’s beyond comprehension. Furthermore, as far as we are aware, the Central Government had no role in this bridge—yet, they showed up to take the credit. ....Nitish Kumar is finished. The JD(U) now has only a few months left. Based on the political developments that have unfolded, it is clear that the JD(U) is heading towards its end...”Pandey told ANI.The remarks follow Prime Minister Narendra Modi 's inauguration of the Rs 4,280-crore bridge over the Ganga on November 21. Kumar was not present at the main ceremony in Vaishali, which was attended by Modi, Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary and Union Minister Chirag Paswan.The event also drew criticism from RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav, who questioned the decision to name the bridge after a living political leader. Speaking to ANI, Yadav argued that memorials were traditionally associated with departed figures and suggested that the naming indicated Kumar was “politically finished”.Yadav further claimed that Kumar had already inaugurated the bridge earlier and alleged that the Centre had not funded the project.Despite missing the inauguration ceremony, Kumar met Modi at Patna airport before the Prime Minister's visit to Vaishali. Modi later shared a post on X, saying, “It was a delight to meet Nitish Kumar Ji at Patna airport.”
Article Summary: Pandey's remarks come amid a political controversy over Kumar's absence from the inauguration of the Nitish Setu bridge in Vaishali district. The JMM leader accused the BJP of taking credit for its construction despite, as he claimed, having no contribution to it.

Article Title: PM Modi announces Rs 2 lakh ex-gratia for families of victims in Kota, Kutch mishaps
Article Text:
​PM Modi

Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday expressed grief over the loss of lives in separate mishaps in Kota, Rajasthan, and Kutch, Gujarat, and announced financial assistance for the families of those killed and injured.In two separate posts on X, PM Modi conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and wished those injured a speedy recovery.Reacting to the mishap in Kota, PM Modi said, "Pained to learn about the loss of lives in a tragic mishap in Kota, Rajasthan. Article Title: NCB busts interstate pharma drugs syndicate
Article Text:
The agency seized more than five lakh tablets, capsules and bottles of pharmaceutical preps

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

SRINAGAR: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) has busted an interstate network involved in supplying pharmaceutical drugs from Delhi to the Kashmir Valley and has arrested four suspects so far.The agency seized more than five lakh tablets, capsules and bottles of pharmaceutical preparations containing tramadol hydrochloride, alprazolam, nitrazepam and codeine.The NCB said the investigation is focused on identifying where codeine-based cough syrup (CBCS) was diverted from the legitimate pharmaceutical supply chain and disrupting the network that moved it into illicit circulation.In a statement, the NCB statement said that acting on specific intelligence, its Jammu unit intercepted a Srinagar-bound passenger bus near a toll plaza in Chenani in Udhampur district on Nov 16. “The team seized around 7 kg of CBCS from a resident of Doda,” the statement said, adding that follow-up investigation in the Kashmir Valley led to the suspected principal recipient, a resident of Anantnag district, who has been arrested.“Pursuing the supply links in Delhi, NCB Jammu and NCB Delhi apprehended persons linked to the Delhi supply operation and recovered 356 bottles of CBCS on Nov 18, 2026,” the statement said.“Further enquiries led to a clandestine godown operating from rented premises in Sahadara, Delhi. Searches on Nov 18 and 19 yielded more than 5,00,000 tablets, capsules and bottles of pharmaceutical preparations containing tramadol hydrochloride, alprazolam, nitrazepam and codeine,” the NCB said, adding that it has registered a case under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Article Summary: The NCB said the investigation is focused on identifying where codeine-based cough syrup (CBCS) was diverted from the legitimate pharmaceutical supply chain. The agency seized more than five lakh tablets, capsules and bottles of pharmaceutical preparations containing codeine.

Article Title: In bizarre mix-up, Asaduddin Owaisi accorded guard of honour meant for Supreme Court judge in Uttar Pradesh
Article Text:
AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi at Saharanpur Circuit House

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: In a protocol mix-up, Saharanpur Police in Uttar Pradesh on Saturday mistakenly accorded a guard of honour to AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi instead of a Supreme Court judge, who was the intended recipient of the ceremonial honour.According to reports, uniformed police personnel were stationed at the Saharanpur Circuit House to accord a guard of honour to the Supreme Court judge. However, before the judge arrived, the AIMIM chief reached the venue around 11.30 am with his convoy.Owaisi was in Saharanpur as part of a scheduled visit to meet Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) founder and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad. The meeting was significant in the backdrop of the alliance between Owaisi's All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) and the Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) for the February-March 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.Mistaking Owaisi's convoy and security detail for those of the scheduled dignitary, the deployed police personnel presented him with a guard of honour as the Hyderabad MP stepped out of his vehicle.Visuals showed Owaisi accepting the salute before entering the Circuit House. A video of the incident subsequently circulated widely on social media.Earlier in the day, Owaisi addressed a joint press conference with Azad in Saharanpur, where he claimed that their alliance, the Samajik Parivartan Morcha, had already caused "discomfort" and "distress" to Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath and Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav.Taking aim at the SP, Owaisi cited electoral outcomes from 2014, 2017, 2019, 2022 and 2024, questioning the party's record of contesting elections outside Uttar Pradesh."The reality is this: if you believe that the alliance you are talking about can defeat the BJP—well, it won't be able to. Look at 2014, 2017, 2019, 2022, and 2024—and then you accuse us of 'going there to contest.' The Samajwadi Party contested 640 seats across 13 states! You even contested in Andhra Pradesh. You won 114, and 111 of those were won from UP..." Owaisi said.He was referring to the SP's 114 MLAs across three states, including 111 in Uttar Pradesh, two in Maharashtra and one in Gujarat.
Article Summary: Saharanpur Police in Uttar Pradesh mistakenly accorded a guard of honour to AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi. Supreme Court judge was intended recipient of the ceremonial honour. A video of the incident subsequently circulated widely on social media.

Article Title: 'Will write to EC': Akhilesh alleges UP officials working as 'BJP functionaries' ahead of polls
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday alleged that some government officials were working as "BJP functionaries" in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the assembly elections.While addressing a press conference at the party headquarters in Lucknow, Akhilesh said the SP would submit a detailed complaint to the Election Commission after consulting its leaders."We will write to the Election Commission with examples of officials who have continuously worked as BJP functionaries for the last 10 years," he said, according to news agency PTI."The letter will carry signatures of our MLAs, MLCs and members of Parliament from both Houses," he added.Alleging that officials were not being transferred despite complaints, Yadav cited the example of an officer, without naming him, who he claimed was involved in irregularities during a previous bypoll."I appeal to all our colleagues, leaders and booth-level workers to keep their voter lists in order. If we win our booths, we will form the government. If we fall behind at the booth level, the BJP can attempt any conspiracy," he said.Akhilesh also accused the state government of corruption in various projects and referred to CAG reports concerning government departments."This government is a master in corruption. Uttar Pradesh will progress only when this government is removed," he said.Akhilesh also alleged that voters belonging to the PDA (Backward, Dalit and Minority) communities were being targeted and claimed that the Election Commission was colluding with the BJP.
Article Summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav alleges some government officials are working as "BJP functionaries" in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the assembly elections. Yadav said the SP would submit a detailed complaint to the Election Commission after consulting its leaders.

Article Title: ‘Local DCP suddenly on leave, new DCP in’: CJP's Dipke hints at jail time; Delhi Police detains protesters - top developments

Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijit Dipke, along with Chief Spokesperson Saurav Das, National Spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka and Singer Vishal Dadlani during a protest seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter roll deletions at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Park.

NEW DELHI: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke in another X post on Monday claimed that the local Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) in his hometown had “suddenly gone on leave” and that a new officer had been brought in to take charge.Dipke’s remarks came amid party's earlier claim that he and fellow CJP leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Dass could be arrested before October 10 under the National Security Act (NSA) or other provisions.AISA national president Neha Bora on Monday claimed that protesting journalists have been detained at the Delhi Cantonment Police Station.In a post on X, Neha said "Rosy and other protesting journalists are detained at Delhi Cantt PS. Team of lawyer comrades are in touch with them.But if any lawyer can be at the PS immediately, pls DM."Rosie is among the three female journalists who filed complaint alleging sexual harassment by police personnel during a protest in the New Delhi area on October 3.The complants have been transferred to the Crime Branch at Kamla Market for further action.Delhi Police also detained several protesters outside Parliament Street Police Station who were demonstrating over an alleged incident of sexual misconduct involving three women journalists during an October 3 protest at Jantar Mantar.The protesters alleged that they had been demonstrating since 6pm on Sunday, demanding registration of an FIR in the case. Police detained them around 7am on Monday following a clash, with protesters alleging they were treated poorly despite only seeking registration of an FIR. Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Derek O’Brien also extended support to Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders as party spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka claimed that multiple sources had warned that the three could be arrested before October 10 under the National Security Act (NSA) or other equivalent provisions.“With you all the way 🪳🪳stay strong. ‘10 Oct poora desh aa raha hai…’,” O’Brien said in a post on X while replying to Dipke.CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke reacting to the claim said they would not be intimidated by the possibility of action under laws such as the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) or National Security Act (NSA).“If the Govt believes that the threat of UAPA, NSA or years behind bars will scare us into silence, it won’t,” Dipke said in a post on X, adding that the protesters were prepared to spend “months or years in jail” but would not back down from their campaign to “save democracy”.He further said that they follow the path shown by Mahatma Gandhi and continue to resist “peacefully and non-violently”, despite what he described as attempts by the state to intimidate them.The developments come amid the CJP-led campaign against the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The protesters have been demanding accountability from chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the exercise and have announced further mobilisation on October 10 in Delhi.
Article Summary: AISA national president Neha Bora claims that protesting journalists have been detained at the Delhi Cantonment Police Station. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke reacting to the claim said they would not be intimidated by the possibility of action under laws such as the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act.

Article Title: Food poisoning scare in MP: Over 100 children, 12 adults hospitalised after eating chowmein at village fair
Article Text:
(Representative) At a local fair in Hiri village, more than 100 children and 12 adults became ill after eating chowmein, reporting intense stomach pain soon after.





BALAGHAT: At least 118 children fell ill after allegedly consuming contaminated chowmein at a village fair in Hirri under Kirnapur police station limits in Balaghat district on Saturday night.The children complained of stomach pain after eating chowmein and were rushed to the community health centre in Kirnapur, where treatment was started.Of them, 48 were referred to the district hospital in Balaghat for better medical care. Twelve adults were also admitted to the district hospital.Collector Aditya Singh visited the district hospital on Sunday morning and enquired about the health of the admitted children and other patients. He interacted with the children and sought updates from doctors on their condition.“Around 118 children were affected, of whom 48 are currently under observation. Their condition is stable,” the collector said.He directed the medical team to ensure proper treatment and adequate healthcare facilities for all patients.
Article Summary: At least 118 children fell ill after allegedly consuming contaminated chowmein at a village fair in Hirri under Kirnapur police station limits in Balaghat district on Saturday night. Of them, 48 were referred to the district hospital for better medical care.

Article Title: Son of Delhi doctor accused of killing domestic help dies; father moves court for interim bail
Article Text:
In photos: The accused Dr Manish Gupta; the victim domestic help





NEW DELHI: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail following the death of his 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, on November 19.Gupta has sought temporary release to attend his son's last rites and be with his family during the bereavement. He is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026, and is facing trial in the murder case before Saket District Court.Additional Sessions Judge Anuj Aggarwal took note of the application and directed Delhi Police to submit a verification report. The court has listed the matter for hearing on Saturday.Moving the application on Gupta's behalf, advocate Kamal Nayan Tiwari submitted that the accused was facing an extremely difficult situation following the sudden death of his only child. He argued that Gupta, as the deceased's father, had an emotional and moral responsibility to attend the last rites, but his continued custody had prevented him from doing so.The counsel told the court that he received a call from Gupta's wife on November 20, informing him that their 19-year-old son had died a day earlier. The application stated that the death had come as a devastating shock to the family and that Gupta was unable to be present with them because he was in custody.Parth was also named as a suspect in the charge sheet filed by Delhi Police in the domestic help murder case and had been questioned during the investigation.
Article Summary: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail. His 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, died on November 19. Gupta is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026.

Article Title: Rajasthan Congress chief demands CM Sharma resign over panchayat poll setback
Article Text:
PCC Chief Govind dotasara and LoP Tikaram Jully with Party workers Celebrate Panchayati Raj election results Friday





JAIPUR: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet, terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.Addressing a news conference at the Congress office in Jaipur, Dotasra said the state govt was focused on optics rather than governance. “The state govt appears more interested in publicity and ceremonial events than addressing people’s problems,” he said.Taking aim at Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s earlier description of BJP’s urban local body performance as a “landslide victory,” Dotasra argued the results did not support the claim. He said BJP’s lead over Congress was marginal and claimed that “nearly 64% of voters voted against it” in the urban polls.“People have exposed the PM’s claim (in rural polls). Modi should be wary of the ‘facts’ fed to him by Rajasthan BJP, which only ends up embarrassing him,” Dotasra said.He reiterated his demand for resignations, saying, “If the CM and his ministers have even a little moral responsibility left, they should resign and tell the PM and the Union home minister that they have failed to meet the expectations of Rajasthan’s people.”Dotasra alleged the Sharma govt failed to address inflation, healthcare, fertiliser and seed availability for farmers, employment and women’s safety. Referring to alleged irregularities in medicines and medical equipment supplied to pregnant women, he accused the govt of evading accountability for maternal deaths. He also alleged that job seekers were facing police action. Unemployed youth, he said, were being met with “batons and police action instead of recruitment opportunities. ”Dotasra also criticised Sharma over remarks directed at former chief minister Ashok Gehlot , saying Gehlot’s advice to keep relatives away from govt affairs stemmed from his experience as a three-term CM. “Instead of addressing the issue, the current CM appears rattled. The language he used against a former CM was unacceptable. Even a street drunkard would not use such language,” Dotasra said.Questioning Sharma’s emphasis on high-profile visits and public events, Dotasra took a swipe at the ceremonial aspects of VIP tours. “A ‘Radhe Radhe’ stole, a memento, a helicopter ride and visits by the PM and the Union HM—but what did Rajasthan’s people get? You are not running an event management company; you are running a govt,” he said.
Article Summary: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet. He terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.

Article Title: Raut claims Rs 150cr being offered to MPs to back delimitation bill, Mahajan says allegations childish
Article Text:
File photo

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed on Saturday that MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill”, even as BJP minister Girish Mahajan dismissed it as a “childish allegation”.Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued. He added that Congress party’s performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat elections reflected the country’s changing mood.Interacting with the media during his visit to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Saturday, Raut alleged that BJP was attempting to secure support for the proposed delimitation bill and questioned why a Parliament session was not being convened.“Remember this figure if Maharashtra ’s MPs support the bill,” Raut said, alleging that some prominent politicians in the state had been entrusted with arranging the money and securing support. He also questioned Union home minister Amit Shah ’s frequent visits to Mumbai over the past two months, alleging that political negotiations were being conducted from the city.BJP minister Girish Mahajan, speaking in Jalgaon, said that Raut makes “childish allegations.No one takes him seriously anymore.”Raut said Congress’s good performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat samiti and zilla parishad elections was the outcome of public pressure preventing electoral malpractice and keeping the election machinery under check. “If this public pressure continues until 2029, the BJP will not return to power. It is not 100% but 500% certain,” he said.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill’ Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued.

NAVI MUMBAI: A 25-year-old woman on Monday lodged a rape complaint at CBD-Belapur police station against habitual offender Shailendra Dwivedi (50), who allegedly posed as a journalist.Dwivedi was arrested by Ulwe police on November 12 in a cheating and criminal breach of trust case for allegedly duping Thane trader Vijay Jha and four others of Rs 19 lakh in a flat sale deal. Article Title: Swargate rape trial adjourned to Dec 5 as survivor breaks down in court
Article Text:
The incident occurred on Feb 25, 2025 at the Swargate bus depot

Pune





: Proceedings in the Swargate bus rape case were adjourned for the day on Saturday after the 26-year-old survivor broke down in tears while recording her deposition as the trial commenced before District and Sessions Judge D. S. Deshmukh.While narrating the sequence of events before the court, the woman became overwhelmed with emotion. Taking note of her condition, the court granted her a short recess to compose herself and have some water. However, as she remained visibly distressed even after the break, the court adjourned the hearing and scheduled the next date for Dec 5.For the prosecution, the Maharashtra govt has appointed senior advocate Ajay Misar as the special public prosecutor. He is representing the state in the trial, assisted by advocates Prathamesh Shingane, Rakesh Sonar, and Radhika Navandar-Joshi.According to the prosecution’s case, early on Feb 25, 2025, the woman was waiting at the Swargate bus depot to travel to Satara when a man posing as a conductor misled her and took her inside a stationary bus, where he allegedly raped her before walking away. The woman subsequently raised an alarm.Following a complaint, Swargate police registered an FIR and traced the accused to his native village, where he was hiding in a sugar cane field. Police deployed sniffer dogs and drone cameras to track his movements and apprehended him after a two-day operation when he ventured out of the field.
Article Summary: The 26-year-old survivor broke down in tears while recording her deposition as the trial commenced. The incident occurred on Feb 25, 2025 at the Swargate bus depot in Pune. A man posing as a conductor misled her and took her inside a stationary bus, where he allegedly raped her.

Article Title: Class XI student dies after being hit by suburban train near Singaperumal Koil
Article Text:
Chennai:





A 16-year-old schoolgirl died after being hit by a suburban electric train while crossing the railway tracks near Singaperumal Koil railway station in Chengalpet district on Friday evening. She succumbed to her injuries at the govt hospital in Chengalpet on Saturday morning.The deceased, Yuvasree, was the daughter of Kumar, a resident of Malrosapuram near Singaperumal Koil. She was studying in Class XI at a private school in Maraimalai Nagar.Police said Yuvasree was returning home after school on Friday when she decided to visit a friend. She got down at Singaperumal Koil railway station and attempted to cross the tracks between the railway station and the Tiruttheri railway gate.A suburban electric train travelling from Chengalpet to Chennai Beach hit her while she was crossing the tracks. She suffered serious injuries and fell near the tracks.Railway police reached the spot after receiving information, rescued her and shifted her to a hospital. She died on Saturday morning despite treatment. Railway police registered a case.
Article Summary: Yuvasree was returning home after school on Friday when she decided to visit a friend. She got down at Singaperumal Koil railway station and attempted to cross the tracks. A suburban electric train travelling from Chengalpet to Chennai Beach hit her. She suffered serious injuries and fell near the tracks and died on Saturday.

Article Title: Case registered against Bigg Boss Tamil 8 winner Muthukumaran under BNS Section 69

Muthukumaran

Bigg Boss Tamil season 8 winner Muthukumaran Jegatheesan has been booked following a complaint from an Instagram influencer who accused him of having sexual relations with her after promising marriage.In her complaint to the Chennai police commissioner, the woman said she met Muthukumaran on Instagram and that their friendship grew into a relationship. She was reportedly admitted to a hospital following a suspected suicide attempt and spoke about the relationship in a video posted on Instagram.

Article Title: TNEB employee held with ganja in Mettur

Salem





: A suspended electricity board employee was arrested on Saturday for smuggling ganja on his two-wheeler in Mettur.Police identified the arrested person as M Joseph, 47, of Matha Kovil area in Mettur. Article Title: Traffic diversions announced in Krishnagiri in view of festivals
Article Text:
traffic diversions

Krishnagiri

:





District police have announced traffic diversions for heavy vehicles and non-pilgrim traffic from 2pm on November 22 to 6am on November 26, in view of Tiruvannamalai Maharatham and Karthigai Deepam festivals.In a media statement, SP GS Anitha stated that heavy vehicles travelling from Bengaluru to Tiruvannamalai , Villupuram, Cuddalore and Puducherry must take the Krishnagiri-Vaniyambadi-Vellore-Cheyyar-Vandavasi-Tindivanam route instead of proceeding through Uthangarai, Chengam and Tiruvannamalai.Vehicles from Bengaluru bound for Vriddhachalam, Chidambaram and Nagapattinam through Krishnagiri will be diverted via Dharmapuri, Thoppur, Salem, Vazhapadi, and Attur.Vehicles from Bargur towards Tiruvannamalai and those arriving through Kuppam will be diverted via Vaniyambadi, Vellore, Cheyyar, Vandavasi, and Tindivanam. Heavy vehicles arriving from Dharmapuri through Manjamedu will be diverted at Puliyur Junction towards Tiruvannamalai Road instead of Pochampally Road.Heavy vehicles travelling from Krishnagiri towards Tiruvannamalai will be diverted to Bargur Road at Jagadevi.All vehicles heading from Krishnagiri to Tiruvannamalai will also be diverted at Kannandahalli near Mathur police station towards Tirupattur.Heavy vehicles using Krishnagiri bypass roads will be diverted at Uthangarai MGR Nagar through Karapattu, Kathavani and Arunapathi toll road towards Tirupattur. Those arriving from Salem via Harur and Uthangarai for Tiruvannamalai will also be redirected through Tirupattur.Heavy vehicles travelling from Tirupattur towards Tiruvannamalai via Singarapettai and Chengam will be rerouted towards Tirupattur. Vehicles from Dharmapuri district proceeding via Irumathur, Puliyur, and Olapatti will use alternative routes notified by police.The SP explained the arrangements at a consultation meeting with truck drivers’ welfare association office-bearers at the district police office and sought their cooperation.
Article Summary: Heavy vehicles travelling from Bengaluru to Tiruvannamalai must take the Krishnagiri-Vaniyambadi-Vellore-Cheyyar-Vandavasi-Tindivanam route. Vehicles from Dharmapuri district proceeding via Irumathur, Puliyur, and Olapatti will use alternative routes.

Article Title: Rash and wrong-side driving: Coimbatore district police book driver, seize private bus, recommend cancellation of licence and permit
Article Text:

COIMBATORE: The Coimbatore district police have seized a private mofussil bus and booked its driver for rash, negligent and wrong-side driving at Pappampatti Pirivu on the Coimbatore–Palladam Road.According to a statement issued by the district police on Tuesday, the incident occurred around 8.30am on Monday while the private bus was heading to Coimbatore from Tirupur. Near Pappampatti Pirivu, which falls under the Sulur police station limits, driver Sakthivel drove the bus at a high speed before abruptly swerving the vehicle to the right and driving against the oncoming traffic on the wrong side of the busy stretch, putting motorists and pedestrians at a grave risk.Several commuters recorded the dangerous manoeuvre and uploaded the footage online, where it quickly gained widespread traction. Acting on a formal complaint lodged by a motorist, the Sulur police registered a case against Sakthivel under Section 281 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) read with Section 184 of the Motor Vehicles Act Police impounded the bus and parked it on the Sulur police station premises for further legal proceedings. Additionally, authorities have written to the regional transport officer recommending the cancellation of Sakthivel’s driving licence as well as the vehicle’s route permit.Reiterating a zero-tolerance stance, the district police warned that strict legal action would be taken against motorists endangering public safety.
Article Summary: The Coimbatore district police seized a private mofussil bus and booked its driver for rash, negligent and wrong-side driving. Driver Sakthivel drove the bus at a high speed before abruptly swerving the vehicle to the right and driving against the oncoming traffic.

Article Title: HC summons three IAS officers in bogus library books scam
Article Text:
HC summons three IAS officers in bogus library books scam

Madurai

:





People at the helm of affairs are bound to answer, observed the Madras high court on Friday, while issuing statutory notices summoning three IAS officers to appear before the court and seeking their explanation in connection with the bogus library books purchase scam.A division bench of Justice G R Swaminathan and Justice M D Sumathi issued the statutory notices to former director of public libraries Jayanthi , former school education department secretary Chandramohan and former managing director of Tamil Nadu textbook and educational services corporation Aarthi.The judges directed the state govt to place before the court the relevant files regarding the procurement of books for public libraries.During the course of the hearing, the state submitted that suggestions collected by the court would be placed for consideration and would be deliberated upon. A comprehensive policy regarding the procurement of books for public libraries would also be issued in eight weeks. The proposed policy would plug all loopholes that had now surfaced, the state submitted.Taking into account that a similar case was pending before the principal seat in Chennai and considering the special facts and circumstances of the case, the judges requested Justice V Lakshminarayanan, holding the roster (V and AC cases) at the principal seat, to monitor the investigation conducted by the DVAC in the scam.During the previous hearing, the court observed, “The government would do well to undertake a detailed probe and come out with a statement as to how procurement of books had taken place for the last 20 years and more. It would be in order if a ‘White paper’ was submitted. The scam had shaken the conscience of the people of Tamil Nadu. Their faith in the system must be restored.”The state submitted that five officials had already been suspended.The court was hearing the contempt petition filed by V Ramasubbu complaining about the non-compliance with the earlier order passed by the court in 2024.
Article Summary: Madras high court summons three IAS officers in bogus library books scam. The judges directed the state govt to place before the court the relevant files regarding the procurement of books for public libraries. The court was hearing the contempt petition filed by V Ramasubbu.

SALEM: A govt school teacher was arrested in Salem district on Sunday night under sections of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act on charges of inappropriate behaviour towards girl students.The arrested teacher, M Sankar, 49, of Vinayagapuram, is serving as a social science teacher in a govt school in the district.According to the complaint, the teacher allegedly made inappropriate remarks to Class X girl students on Nov 5. “He is accused of making a heart-shaped hand gesture towards one student and calling another student ‘Cleopatra’ while commenting on the beauty of her eyes,” said an officer at the all women police station in Attur.The students brought the matter to the notice of the headmaster on Nov 13. The headmaster informed chief educational officer A Ellappan and contacted Childline 1098 seeking intervention.Following the complaint, a member of the child welfare committee visited the school on Nov 14 and conducted an inquiry into the allegations raised by the students.Based on the findings, the headmaster lodged a complaint with the Attur all women police on Sunday. Police registered a case against Sankar and arrested him. He was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: The arrested teacher, M Sankar, 49, of Vinayagapuram, is serving as a social science teacher in a govt school in the district. He is accused of making a heart-shaped hand gesture towards one student and calling another student ‘Cleopatra’

Article Title: Two youths booked for knocking down excise officer with motorcycle in Thodupuzha
Article Text:
Thodupuzha

:





The police have registered a case against two youths who allegedly knocked down and grievously injured an excise inspector with their motorcycle during vehicle checks at Mattupara in Kumaramangalam on Saturday.The accused are Tenz, 23, of Kadavoor, Kothamangalam, who was riding the motorcycle, and Rohith, 22, of Mutharamkunnu, Kumaramangalam, who was riding pillion.The police said a team led by Thodupuzha range excise inspector Lijo Oommen was inspecting vehicles when officers signalled the motorcycle to stop. The rider allegedly accelerated and rammed the inspector. The motorcycle ran over his leg before overturning, injuring both riders.Oommen suffered grievous injuries to his right knee and wounds on his hands and legs. He was admitted to a private hospital in Thodupuzha.During the inspection, officers allegedly recovered four grams of ganja from Tenz and three grams from Rohith. Based on Oommen’s statement recorded at the hospital, the police registered the case under relevant sections of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
Article Summary: The police have registered a case against two youths who allegedly knocked down and grievously injured an excise inspector with their motorcycle. The accused are Tenz, 23, of Kadavoor, Kothamangalam, who was riding the motorcycle, and Rohith, 22, of Mutharamkunnu.
